parameters.query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS board_summaries (id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, as_of TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), body TEXT NOT NULL, item_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, time_window TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', model TEXT, prompt_version TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS board_summaries_as_of_idx ON board_summaries (as_of DESC); ALTER TABLE board_summaries ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS lead TEXT; ALTER TABLE board_summaries ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS highlights JSONB; DO $$ BEGIN IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='board_summaries' AND column_name='window') THEN ALTER TABLE board_summaries RENAME COLUMN "window" TO time_window; END IF; END $$;

WITH window_items AS (SELECT id, received_at, type, title, due_at, student, action_required, amount, teacher, course, source_hint, confidence, source_from, source_subject, action_url, action_target FROM intake_items WHERE received_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' OR (due_at IS NOT NULL AND due_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 hours' AND due_at <= NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days') ORDER BY COALESCE(due_at, received_at)) SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(window_items)), '[]'::json) AS items, COUNT(*)::int AS item_count FROM window_items;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.model, messages: $json.messages, temperature: $json.temperature, max_tokens: $json.max_tokens, think: false }) }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO board_summaries (as_of, body, item_count, time_window, model, prompt_version, lead, highlights) VALUES (($1::json->>'as_of')::timestamptz, $1::json->>'body', ($1::json->>'item_count')::int, $1::json->>'time_window', $1::json->>'model', $1::json->>'prompt_version', $1::json->>'lead', ($1::json->'highlights')::jsonb) RETURNING id, as_of;
